children.dedup_hint: Same action at most once per section; cover only information new to this role.
children.typical_output: Source-text break point -> plot constraints -> continuation output
avoid: Teaching writing knowledge without any actual writing
Vague comments with no evaluation dimensions
One-shot drafting with no revision step
children.pedagogy_notes: Story-chain style continuation.

children.name: Revision and Publishing
children.description: Improve the work through evaluation and revision, and reach real readers.
children.dedup_hint: The evaluation checklist must reuse the exemplar-deconstruction dimensions; at most 1 peer-review round per section.
children.self_study_note: Self-paced adaptation: peer review becomes (a) the AI companion critiquing the learner's draft against the rubric, and (b) the learner critiquing an AI-generated flawed peer draft — the reviewing skill is preserved.

children.name: Self-Assessment Revision Checklist
children.description: Self-check item by item against a checklist and revise
children.dedup_hint: Same action at most once per section; cover only information new to this role.
children.typical_output: Checklist (= deconstruction dimensions) -> tick item by item -> revise >=2 spots
avoid: Teaching writing knowledge without any actual writing
Vague comments with no evaluation dimensions
One-shot drafting with no revision step
children.pedagogy_notes: Picture-and-text checklist with 3 items or fewer.

children.name: Peer Review and Revision
children.description: Structured peer review and revision based on feedback
children.dedup_hint: Same action at most once per section; cover only information new to this role.
children.typical_output: Peer-review form (1 strength + 1 suggestion) -> revise based on feedback
avoid: Teaching writing knowledge without any actual writing
Vague comments with no evaluation dimensions
One-shot drafting with no revision step
children.self_study_note: Solo mode: learner reviews an AI-generated peer draft, then receives companion feedback on their own draft using the same rubric.
children.pedagogy_notes: Sentence frame: 'I like... It would be better if...'.

children.name: Read-Aloud Polishing
children.description: Find awkward phrasing by reading aloud and polish it
children.dedup_hint: Same action at most once per section; cover only information new to this role.
children.typical_output: Read aloud -> mark stumbles/awkward spots -> polish

One-shot drafting with no revision step
children.pedagogy_notes: Read to a deskmate; the listener raises a hand to signal 'I didn't get that'.
